new: Screens in the studio: a video or audio player with a playlist, placed in a scene from the Add pane (Screen, Audio player, or a video's card). Its sound comes from where it stands.
Shared by default: everyone at the circle sees and hears the same moment. Plays for: Each person makes it everyone's own.
A control bar under it (previous, play, next, seek, volume) shows when you point at it. Who can use the controls: Anyone lets people use it without editing.
Videos (.mp4, .mov, .m4v, .mkv, .webm) go into the scene's videos/ folder through the Upload pane. Optional: Convert videos to MP4 (H.264) on the relay, 720p with For Quest.
Rooms need every device updated (format networks-45).
test: Upload an MP4 into a scene, add a screen of it, press play: does it play in the headset, picture and sound?
Two headsets at one studio circle: does play, pause, next and seek on one reach the other at the same moment?
Set Who can use the controls to Anyone, turn editing off: does the bar show when you point at it, and work?
Walk away and back, or hide it with a cube: does it pick up at the right moment?
Try Convert videos to MP4 with a phone video on the test place.
untested: Everything on a Quest: its video decoder, the frame rate with a 1080p video playing, the bar with a real ray, the sound through HRTF.
MP4 (H.264) playback in a browser: the test browser here has no H.264, so only WebM was played.
A long video converted on Coolify; an iPhone playing a screen.
